name: @humanlayer/riptide-electron
description: Secure Electron host for the Riptide UI
author: HumanLayer

scripts.dev:compiled-daemon: bun run stage-daemon:local && RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_DAEMON_MODE=staged RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_STAGED_DAEMON_PATH=$PWD/resources/bin/riptided bun run dev
scripts.package:local: bun run stage-daemon:local && RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_PACKAGE_BUILD=true bun run --cwd ../riptide-ui build:electron:local && bun run build:main && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.local.yml --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:dev-package: bun run stage-daemon:dev && RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_PACKAGE_BUILD=true bun run --cwd ../riptide-ui build:electron:dev && bun run build:main
scripts.build:beta-package: bun run stage-daemon:beta && RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_PACKAGE_BUILD=true bun run --cwd ../riptide-ui build:electron:beta && bun run build:main
scripts.build:prod-package: bun run stage-daemon:prod && RIPTIDE_ELECTRON_PACKAGE_BUILD=true bun run --cwd ../riptide-ui build:electron:prod && bun run build:main
scripts.package:dev:dir: bun run build:dev-package && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.dev.yml --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:dev:unsigned: bun run build:dev-package && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.dev.yml --config.mac.identity=null --publish never
scripts.package:beta: bun run build:beta-package && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.beta.yml --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.package:prod: bun run build:prod-package && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.prod.yml --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.test: bun run build:main && bun vitest run
